messages:
Carla R.: Quick ping on PM-2026-142 postmortem. We have a couple of remediations still overdue and L3 wants a status snapshot. Please post short updates so I can include in the digest.

Carla R.: Actions from the doc:
```
A1 - tighten mux timeout and add retry backoff (owner: Omar S.) - due 2026-03-20
A2 - add monitoring for KV cache eviction rate (owner: Maya K.) - due 2026-03-18
A3 - implement model fallback routing for hot-queue overloads (owner: Omar S.) - due 2026-03-22
```

Omar S.: A1 partially done. PR open: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/mux/pull/1123. Still need to validate at scale; running a 6h load test now. ETA for merge if green: 2026-03-21 09:00 UTC.

Maya K.: A2 deployed to staging yesterday and I tuned thresholds after a couple of spikes. Waiting on a 48h window to be sure. Marking "verifying" for now.

SRE Bot: :warning: Action A1 is past due by 1 day. Owner: Omar S.

Carla R.: Omar, can you shorten ETA if load test is flaky? If you need help with load infra ping @Jared L. I'll escalate after EOD if no update.

Omar S.: Load job flaked twice due to a harness timing issue. Spun up an isolated run now; expected finish in ~3h. If that fails again I'll propose a canary-only rollout to unblock.

Jared L.: I can spare an infra node to help stabilize the harness. Omar, want me to repro the flaky run with your branch?

Omar S.: Yes please, that would help. I'll drop the branch and steps in the PR.Thanks Jared.

Maya K.: If A1 needs to be canaried, A2 thresholds will need a minor tweak due to the different traffic shape. Happy to do that once Omar confirms a canary plan.

Carla R.: TL;DR for L3 rollup: A2 verifying (Maya), A1 overdue-in-progress (Omar) - PR + load tests; ETA tentative 2026-03-21; A3 not started (Omar) - please post start date by EOD or I'll ask leads to reassign.

Omar S.: Start date for A3: 2026-03-24 if we don't hit any more infra delays. If infra can't clear earlier, propose reassigning A3 to Maya for initial fallback rule implementation.

Carla R.: Please confirm reassign option by EOD. If no response I'll escalate to Jared and Eng leads. :triangular_flag_on_post: 

SRE Bot: :mega: Reminder scheduled: escalate A3 tomorrow 09:00 UTC if owner doesn't update.

Jared L.: Thanks, will monitor and help reassign if needed. Jared -> ping Omar in the PR once repro runs finish.

Carla R.: Thanks everyone. I'll include the summary in the L3 digest and reopen if any estimates slip. Please @mention me for urgent escalations.
